ownerInstruction: Use conservative allowances: fully laden van up to 3.5 tonnes and Tesla up to 3.1 tonnes, potentially parked together.

assumptions.note: Axle fractions, track widths, wheel imbalance and movement factor are explicit study assumptions, not vehicle data or prescribed Eurocode values. The 30 kN jack case is a separate local floor action, not additional vehicle mass. Actual plated axle ratings and tyre/jack contact patches remain required.

codeBasis.provisionalCategory: G: both gross vehicle allowances exceed 30 kN
codeBasis.basis: Use first-generation EN 1991-1-1 with the applicable UK National Annex as the provisional project basis. JRC guidance gives Category G for 30-160 kN vehicles and a 5 kPa UDL. Exact UK concentrated-action requirements, combinations, access restrictions and edition must be confirmed by the designer. No 40-90 kN generic axle range is silently adopted as the selected UK axle load.

limits: Two vehicles together is the operational brief, not a verified parking layout or full-deck load-pattern analysis.
UDL, axle pairs and local jack sensitivities are evaluated separately; the full vehicle weights are not added again to those actions.
Transverse spreading through topping/infill, tyre and jack patches, punching, beam torsion and joint transfer remain unverified.
The paired-wheel study assumes an axle parallel to the precast beam. Turning, wheelbase, both axles, edge approaches and loads shared through the central wall/opening heads need full layout analysis.
Vehicle weights are variable actions and must not be credited as permanent resistance to groundwater uplift.
No car lift, heavier vehicle or construction plant is included in this parking brief.
